You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Finance, and external partners — and you will be a key thought partner on where product is going and how we get there. The product organization is at the center of our next phase of growth — building new financial infrastructure, exploring new geographies, and reimagining what a consumer fintech platform can do.
